services.desc: We have been offshore and have also fished Back Bay quite a bit in recent weeks. Posted on 1/27/2023 The fishing has been excellent. Offshore we have been catching red grouper, key west grunts, permit, african pompano, nice yellowtail snapper, lane snapper and mangrove... read

blurb: If you are looking for the ultimate Southwest Florida fishing charter, look no further as Fort Myers Fishing Adventures can make your saltwater fishing dream a reality. We offer a unique charter service in Southwest Florida, as we will be fishing near-shore and back-bay, in the vicinity of Fort Myers Beach, Sanibel Island and Captiva Island. Simply put…WE GO WHERE THE FISH
